content.title: 'Age Of Attraction' Reunion: Start Time, How To Watch And What To Expect
content.text: Age of Attraction. (L to R) John Merrill, Theresa Demaria in episode 107 of Age of Attraction. COURTESY OF NETFLIXThe first season of Netflix’s new reality dating show, Age of Attraction, is wrapping up with a dramatic reunion episode that fans won’t want to miss. However, it may be a bit trickier to access if you’re expecting to watch it on the streamer.Hosted by The Viall Files’ Nick Viall and Natalie Joy, the series follows 40 singles, ranging from 22 to 60 years old, as they attempt to build connections based solely on chemistry and compatibility. They were whisked away to a scenic mountain retreat, where the only rule is that they can’t ask about each other’s age.After finding a connection, couples who wanted to move forward with the experiment exchanged rings and revealed their ages in the Promise Room. Six couples then left the retreat to test their relationships in the real world. They moved in together, met family members and faced outside opinions for the first time.Forbes‘Age Of Attraction’ Cast Ages: See The Couples’ Shocking Age GapsFrom Theresa’s concerns about how her kids will react to her relationship with John to Andrew’s hesitations about Libby’s readiness to be a stepmom, each couple is forced to decide whether their connection is one can last. Ultimately, four couples commit to moving their relationships forward. Logan even gets down on one knee and proposes to Vanessa despite their relationship issues.Tonight’s reunion will shed light on what happened after those final decisions: Who stayed together? Who called it quits? And what happened after the cameras stopped rolling? Here’s what to know about the Age of Attraction Season 1 reunion, including what time it starts and how to watch the special, since it won’t be streaming on Netflix, where the episodes originally premiered.What Time Is The Age Of Attraction Season 1 Reunion?Age of Attraction. (L to R) Vanessa Drozda, Logan Goodrid in episode 108 of Age of Attraction. COURTESY OF NETFLIX The Age of Attraction Season 1 reunion will premiere on Wednesday, April 1 at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT on The Viall Files podcast.Who Will Be Attending The Age Of Attraction Season 1 Reunion?Age of Attraction. (L to R) Leah Woolfolk, Theresa Demaria, Chris Dahlan, John Merrill, Vanessa Drozda, Logan Goodrid, Libby Vodicka, Andrew Wheeler in episode 107 of Age of Attraction.COURTESY OF NETFLIXHosted by Viall and his wife, Natalie, all six couples from Season 1 are expected to reunite, including Theresa and John, Vanessa and Logan, Libby and Andrew, Leah and Chris, Pfeiffer and Derrick, and Vanelle and Jorge. (However, a newly released teaser from suggests that Pfeiffer might not be involved after all.)“Promising answers, shocking updates, and plenty of drama, the reunion will reveal if the couples’ bold commitments to each other have stood the test of time,” according to Netflix’s Tudum.Age of Attraction. (L to R) Leah Woolfolk, Chris Dahlan in episode 108 of Age of Attraction.COURTESY OF NETFLIXThe Age of Attraction Season 1 reunion will not stream on Netflix. Instead, it will be released as a standalone episode of The Viall Files podcast. The special will stream live starting at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT on The Viall Files YouTube page.Why Is The Age of Attraction Season 1 Reunion Not Airing On Netflix?Age of Attraction. (L to R) Natalie Joy, Nick Viall in episode 104 of Age of Attraction.COURTESY OF NETFLIXUnlike Netflix’s other reality dating shows, like the popular Love Is Blind franchise, the reunion episode will not air on the platform. For now, the episode will be exclusively streaming on Viall’s podcast. It’s unclear whether the special will be available to stream on Netflix in the future.Is There A Trailer For The Age Of Attraction Season 1 Reunion?Age of Attraction. (L to R) Pfeifer Hill, Derrick Fleming in episode 106 of Age of Attraction. COURTESY OF NETFLIXYes! On March 25, Viall dropped the Age of Attraction reunion trailer on his YouTube page. In the teaser, he asks the couples to share who is still together and points out that Pfeiffer is not present, asking if anyone knows where she is. Things also get heated between several couples, including Theresa and John and Leah and Chris. Check out the dramatic clip below.
